target_title: Deep Tech Advisor, Physicist, Engineer, Inventor, Attorney, Investor
body:
I am Justin, an M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology working in embedded firmware and hardware. I came across your background in optical sensing and catheter based diagnostics and wanted to reach out, since a lot of my recent project work sits in that same space of sensors, real time control, and hardware bring up.

I am currently looking at the Embedded Systems and Firmware Engineering Intern role at OrthoIQ and wanted a more experienced perspective on whether my background actually lines up with what a medical device hardware team needs, and if there is someone specific you think I should be talking to about roles like this.

I would really appreciate any thoughts you are willing to share.
hook_used: His background at InfraReDx and Axsun spans optical sensing and catheter based medical device diagnostics, directly relevant to the OrthoIQ intern role and a genuine reason to ask him specifically, not a recruiter, for a fit read and a referral pointer.
